summary: Retested the iteration_65 follow-ups. Backend: 3 of 3 pytest pass (tests/test_iter66_doc_upload_email_rl.py). Frontend: 5 of 6 checks pass. There were 2 real uploads (1 API, 1 UI). Each set admin_email_sent=True with admin_email_error=None, and the email went to _admin_target() (CONTRACT_SUBMISSIONS_TO / EMAIL_REPLY_TO), not to the customer. The API submit took 0.85s including the email. 'E-Mail fehlgeschlagen' no longer appears on the new submission. Used codes show 'VERWENDET' plus 'TEST_UIKunde66 · date' (data-testid du-code-used-by-<id>). The upload rate limit holds against random spoofed first XFF entries: 401x4 then 429. forgot-password returns {status:'ok'} in under 2s with no token. The homepage loads with 0 CORS console errors. Bug: the plaintext code is visible right after 'Code erstellen', but it falls back to ····XXXX as soon as 'Aktualisieren' is clicked.

minor.issue: These rate limits still key on the LEFT-most X-Forwarded-For entry, so they can be bypassed by spoofing. Verified: 6 forgot-password calls with a random XFF all returned 200, while the same calls without XFF returned 429 on the 3rd. Only storage_files._check_public_upload_rl was hardened.

Still uses request.client.host, which is the k8s ingress pod IP (10.49.x.x) shared by all visitors. The code-brute-force lockout is therefore effectively global: one attacker locks out every customer. This was an iteration_65 action item and is still open.

If EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY is missing, _send_email_via_emergent returns None without raising (dry-run), and the submission is still marked admin_email_sent=True. Check the returned id before setting the flag.

The single-use code is checked with find_one(status=active) and only marked used after the storage writes, without an atomic find_one_and_update. Two parallel submits can both consume the same one-time code.

Not verified: whether the right-most XFF entry is the real client IP or an ingress/proxy hop. If it is a proxy IP, all users share one bucket of 5 uploads per minute. Please confirm the ingress XFF format.

ui_bugs.issue: onClick={fetchData} passes the click event as the 'fresh' argument, so fresh[r.id] is undefined. After clicking Aktualisieren, a freshly created code shows as ····9B88 instead of MAM39B88 and the copy button disappears. Fix: onClick={() => fetchData()}.

issues: The career popup ([data-testid=career-popup]) opens over the transactional upload page and blocks the 'Dokumente senden' button until it is dismissed. Suppress it on /dokument-upload and similar form pages.
The public upload page has no data-testid on the name, code, file and submit inputs.

action_items: AdminDocumentUploads: change the Aktualisieren onClick to () => fetchData() so fresh plaintext codes survive a refresh.

Use a single shared client-IP helper based on the right-most or trusted XFF entry in auth.py _rl_check, server.py _client_ip/1764, applications.py, contract_submissions.py and formular_access fail-log.
Only set admin_email_sent=True when _send_email_via_emergent returns a message id.
Make one-time code consumption atomic (find_one_and_update status active->used before storage writes, or roll back).
Do not show the career popup on /dokument-upload, and add data-testids to that page.
seed_data_creation: TEST_iter66_* codes and submissions were created and then deleted. No users were created.
